method: Independent mocked integration with actual SQLite persistence, shared D1 SQL via an atomic SQLite adapter, actual Worker routes/dispatch, and provider fetch stubs. No real mail or production credentials.

checks.name: node: history is not backfilled and duplicate concurrent save enqueues exactly one confirmation
node: actual drain calls fixed provider once, persists accepted status and never resends a duplicate
node: save succeeds independently of ambiguous delivery; uncertain jobs are never automatically replayed
node: known rejection backs off60s/300s and fails after three; expired lease rejects stale completion
d1: history is not backfilled and duplicate concurrent save enqueues exactly one confirmation
d1: actual drain calls fixed provider once, persists accepted status and never resends a duplicate
d1: save succeeds independently of ambiguous delivery; uncertain jobs are never automatically replayed
d1: known rejection backs off60s/300s and fails after three; expired lease rejects stale completion
Configured per-client cap rejects new save atomically and permits a real retry after the rolling window
Actual Worker signup route saves+queues but does not send before background dispatch; authorized response reveals counts only
Dispatch rejects unauthorized requests before unavailable-store construction and never leaks internal errors
Actual Worker cap returns429 and creates no rejected signup or outbox job
Periodic bridge remains fixed/authenticated and still runs if local SQLite drain fails

review.privacy: Cloudflare address/message processing, keyed network identifier, delivery status, delayed/failed receipt, no ownership verification, no duplicate resend, and unmonitored sender are disclosed. Thank-you copy does not claim inbox delivery.
review.security: Fixed account endpoint/from/template; server-only runtime secrets; HMAC network key; fixed authenticated bridge with no redirects; lazy auth-before-store construction; token+attempt+lease guarded completion; sanitized outcomes/counts.
review.scope: Only future genuinely new entries enqueue. Historical and duplicate entries are not mailed. Separate host lists can each produce one receipt. No bulk campaign/backfill.

limitations: Provider delivery was mocked; this audit sent no real mail and did not inspect an inbox.
D1 SQL/transaction behavior was exercised via a SQLite adapter, not a production D1 write.
Configured over-budget requests return429 without saving; successful signup is independent of later provider delivery.
Ambiguous/expired sends require operator review and are not automatically retried; known transient failures have at most3 attempts.
